label: No existing skill declares any candidate decision phrase; the only competing vocabulary is sk-design description word decision and its decision tree, colour decision and color decision signals, which the candidate set does not overlap.

The routing fix must refresh both compiled graph artifacts, skill-graph.json and the SQLite database the daemon reads; the freshness checker compares both against on-disk graph-metadata and reports STALE COMPILED when either is older.

Gap 1 belongs to a new packet in specs/system-skill-advisor (next free 034), not a 043 child: 031 fixed the same class of gap by editing system-spec-kit graph-metadata and filing under the advisor track, and 043 goal D1 freezes its children to the pipeline, writer or save step.

Gaps 2 and 3 belong to 043 children because both change the decision-capture pipeline; one child each (008 state scoping, 009 chat evidence) gives clean closure, while a single 008 is consistent with 007 precedent but merges two different proofs.
The fixes do not collide in code: gap 2 changes capture-core, the writer, the api barrel and the matcher; gap 3 changes chat-questions and save.md; they share no file.
Gap 2 should land first: it changes where data lives and needs a migration note, while gap 3 only adds fields to candidates that are printed, not stored.

Gap 1 is independent and can ship in parallel on the advisor track, but it should ship after gap 2 or point its DECISION intent at the save workflow that carries the scoped behavior, so routing does not lead users into the shared-state bug.

Verification cost is uneven: gap 1 needs graph compile, freshness strict, the 42-case regression corpus plus new decision cases, a short-prompt probe and the doctor skill check; gap 2 needs hooks node --test, writer and matcher vitest, a two-project temp test and the state README; gap 3 needs chat-questions unit tests, a larger labeled set and the save wording.

The review report symlinked_queue_path_escape finding is adjacent but not closed by the project token: the token scopes data, it does not enforce real-path containment, and a strict containment check would reject every linked project because the sanctioned .skilled symlink resolves outside the project root.

Four items remain before a plan: gap 1 live advisor probe, gap 2 behavior for pre-fix queue files, gap 3 false-reject rate on a larger labeled set, and one 043 child versus two; the graph convergence snapshot and pre-init spec mutation were skipped because both write outside this lineage.
